maddeler.e:
نكتسب (form VIII)
# نَكْتَسِبُ (naktasibu) /nak.ta.si.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# نُكْتَسَبُ (nuktasabu) /nuk.ta.sa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# نَكْتَسِبَ (naktasiba) /nak.ta.si.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# نُكْتَسَبَ (nuktasaba) /nuk.ta.sa.ba/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
